questions.question: What did Hannah do after giving Samuel to the LORD?
options: Prayed and sang a song of praise
Fled from the tabernacle in fear
Wept bitterly and would not be comforted
Stayed silent and returned home alone
questions.answer: Prayed and sang a song of praise

questions.question: What was wrong with Eli's sons, Hophni and Phinehas?
options: They worshiped all the idols of the Philistines
They were wicked, abusing their priestly role
They fled and abandoned the house of God
They were too young to serve as priests
questions.answer: They were wicked, abusing their priestly role

questions.question: A man of God prophesied judgment against the house of Eli.
Eli's sons, Hophni and _____, were corrupt and did not know the LORD.
The boy _____ grew in favor with the LORD and with men.
